threat_event: CUI drawings stored outside the enclave are exposed or reported late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CUI drawings for 2 DoD client facilities found in the BTI repository (SYS-D5)
existing_controls: CUI enclave; CUI training for federal teams
treatment_plan: Purge CUI from SYS-D5; CUI marking check on BTI intake; counsel review of reporting duties
owner: Construction director of federal contracts compliance

threat_event: The BTI tools are compromised through the legacy cloud account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Account outside guardrails; local administrator accounts; management endpoint public until 2026-08
treatment_plan: Move into the landing zone; remove local administrators; vault credentials (group plan GR-02)
owner: Construction division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Ransomware on the project delivery platform or jobsite networks stops project work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field tablets and jobsite networks; SaaS dependency
treatment_plan: Jobsite network standard; weekly platform export
owner: Construction division security and compliance lead

threat_event: The division cannot win DoD awards whose program office requires CMMC Level 2 (C3PAO) (Phase 2 is suspended)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Level 2 (Self) only; no C3PAO assessment scheduled
treatment_plan: Schedule a C3PAO assessment for 2027 Q1 as a voluntary choice
owner: Construction director of federal contracts compliance

threat_event: An SPRS affirmation is inaccurate because the CUI finding was not reflected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Affirmations made before CUI was found outside the enclave
treatment_plan: Counsel decision on whether to update the affirmation; affirmation evidence binder

threat_event: Covered video surveillance equipment is delivered to a federal client
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Affiliate brands hard to recognize in distributor catalogs
treatment_plan: Submittal screening against the covered-entity list; 1-business-day reporting procedure

threat_event: Subcontractors handle FCI or CUI without the required clauses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flowdown riders missing in 23 of 120 sampled federal subcontracts
treatment_plan: Re-paper open subcontracts; CMMC status check before award
owner: Construction director of federal contracts compliance

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a subcontractor payment
A jobsite tablet with drawings is lost or stolen
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: encrypted, managed, remote wipe
owner: Construction division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Jobsite safety video analytics are used to discipline workers unfairly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PPE detection at 60 jobsites; no policy on use of alerts in discipline
treatment_plan: Use alerts for coaching only; no automated discipline (P10)

threat_event: FCI or CUI is entered into the AI estimating assistant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant approved for commercial bids only; no technical block for federal bids
existing_controls: Training; enterprise terms with no model training
treatment_plan: Block uploads from federal project workspaces; CUI marking detection
owner: Construction director of federal contracts compliance

threat_event: Stale external accounts on the project delivery platform expose FCI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 5,200 external users from closed projects still active
treatment_plan: Automatic removal 30 days after project closeout
owner: Construction division security and compliance lead

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting CUI is not reported to DoD within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DIBNet medium assurance certificate held by one person; BTI not in the reporting path
treatment_plan: Second certificate holder; BTI included in the federal reporting procedure
owner: Construction director of federal contracts compliance

threat_event: BIM models are lost after a SaaS vendor failure
owner: Construction division security and compliance lead

threat_event: A departing BTI technician keeps credentials to client and group buildings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing credentials; vault access not reviewed
treatment_plan: Rotate shared credentials on departure; quarterly vault access review

threat_event: Telematics or drone imagery of client sites is exposed
treatment_plan: SSO and MFA for telematics and drone portals
owner: Construction division security and compliance lead
